profile.headline: Senior Staff Engineer, AI and Systems CoDesign @ Meta

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - AI and Systems Codesign
Staff Performance Engineer - AI and Systems Codesign
positions.description:
ARM Architecture Enablement

Drove Meta’s transition to ARM-based server architectures, collaborating with cross-functional teams to validate, optimize, and onboard a wide range of mission-critical applications.

Benchmarked and tuned performance for diverse workloads, including advertising, machine learning, web services, video processing, and large-scale data platforms.

Resolved architecture-specific challenges, ensuring that applications ran reliably and efficiently on ARM hardware.

Enabled key developer tools and infrastructure on ARM, supporting seamless workflows for engineering teams.

Next-Generation HighTDP Compute Platform Enablement

Led the rollout and optimization of Meta’s latest high-capacity server platforms, driving major improvements in performance, efficiency, and scalability for the company’s global infrastructure.

Helped Meta achieve significant cost and energy savings, with new platforms projected to save billions of dollars and hundreds of megawatts of power over their lifetimes.

Defined resource management strategies, including “stacking” multiple workloads on a single server, which increased hardware utilization and reduced operational costs.

Developed and implemented QoS features for resource isolation (Resctrl, scheduling), ensuring reliable and predictable performance even as multiple applications share the same hardware.


Collaboration & Technical Leadership
Worked closely with hardware, infrastructure, and product teams to analyze, benchmark, and optimize system performance for both traditional and next-generation platforms.

Mentored engineers and shared knowledge across the organization, accelerating the adoption of new technologies and best practices.

positions.title: Software Developer in Test III - Performance
positions.description:
Develop performance tools and frameworks, to help other developers test and analyze their applications and/or services, written in Go, Python, Java or Scala.

Design, develop and maintain a web application/RESTful API that aggregates events of daily instance builds using multiple flavors and images, across all of Rackspace's datacenters which is used daily to identify production issues from our Public Cloud, written in AngularJS and Go.

Develop and contribute to Open Source projects such as OpenStack Rally, and SaltStack.

Evaluate new hardware/software configurations, and provide recommendations for deciding on new flavors for Rackspace's Public Cloud.

Provide performance guidance to other products and teams by recommending coding best practices, application & system tuning, and configuration, based on concrete data collected from proper performance tests and benchmarks..

Develop and maintain framework, built on SaltStack, which daily builds and benchmarks instances of several flavor/image combinations across all of our datacenters. It executes a whole suite of benchmarks measuring different aspects of the system, such as CPU, Memory I/O, Storage I/O, and Network performance. The data collected is aggregated to a central database which later can be visualized, or consumed through a web application, or RESTful API, respectively.

Design, develop, and execute performance tests for different products all across Rackspace, including but not limited to Cloud Servers, Cloud Images, Cloud Networks, Rackspace's Private Cloud and more.

positions.title: Software Performance Engineer
positions.description:
Improved average response time of PureApplication management Web UI by 35%, by porting code to plain Java to minimize reflection overhead incurred by Groovy.

Reduced hypervisor memory overhead in PureApplication on Power, by 3GB for each compute node in the rack, adding up to 57GB in the 608-cores version, which enables customers to deploy more instances and helped us meet our performances goals for the release.

Measure and optimize performance of IBM PureApplication System's Web-based frontend, to minimize actual and perceived page load times.

Performance testing of products such as IBM PureApplication System, IBM Workload Deployer, WebSphere Application Server.

Identify bottlenecks in the system and provide better algorithms and/or faster implementations.

Performance tests, include but are not limited to, load testing, stress testing, benchmarking, profiling, measuring response times, concurrency and throughput, JVM and Garbage Collector tuning.

Benchmark and optimize systems, such that maximizes the value to the customer and improves the quality of the product to IBM standards.

Develop and automate performance benchmarks, of several systems in languages like Java, Groovy, Jython, Bash.

positions.title: Software Developer, Researcher
positions.description:
Reduced space-complexity of sequence alignment algorithm from O(N2) to O(N) enabling the application to be run in limited memory computers , such as low-end desktops, and laptops.

Co-authored research paper on parallel strategies for the Needleman-Wunsch algorithm in renowned  bioinformatics conference. [1]

[1]Seguel J., Torres C. "Parallelization of Needleman-Wunsch String Alignment Method" Proceedings of the International Conference on Bioinformatics and Computational Biology, Vol 1, pp. 239 - 244 (2011)

positions.title: Software Developer, Intern
positions.description:
Successfully implemented a sequence alignment algorithm in C with MPI, which ran in a 64-cores supercomputer enabling to complete the computation in a mere 11 minutes, down from 10 hours.

Developed a platform independent FASTA format parser in C with a useful API that efficiently handled gigabytes-sized FASTA files.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Tester
positions.description:
Designed and implemented event-based system derived from the observer design pattern, which reduced coupling and dependency between core modules and third-party libraries.

Increased team productivity by successfully refactoring bad designed legacy code to design patterns.

positions.title: Calculus and Pre-Calculus Tutor
positions.description: Helped students develop and improve quantitative skills in calculus math classes. Also helped them with EDUCOSOFTWARE.
